dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: You've been hard at work, Kukkia.

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: Lady Lauma? What brings you here? Also, I was just cleaning up on the side. It was no trouble at all.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: But you do often come by to maintain the statue as well, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: Yes, occasionally. Did the birds tell you? Or did the Moon Goddess?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Haha, our Goddess did indeed guide me with her light.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It was by that guiding radiance that I noticed you switching out the flowers in front of her statue for new ones, and cleaning the statue's base.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: As such, I do not doubt your devotion. I ask only that you take care of your health as well.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I should be thanking you. Please, come a little closer, Kukkia.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: May the moonlight guard your path...
